name.en: Control an area by having more presence

summary.zh: 多放一个单位，可能就改变一整片区域的归属。
summary.en: One extra unit can change who controls an area.

rules.zh: 各方往同一区域投入可计数的单位或标记，在指定时点比较数量决定控制权或奖励。玩家要在多个区域分配有限力量，避免过量投入，也防止领先被刚好超过；平局如何处理必须明确。
rules.en: Players commit countable units or markers to areas. At a defined time, compare totals to award control or rewards. Divide limited strength between areas, avoid excess investment and protect narrow leads, with explicit tie rules.

loop.zh: 增援或连接到目标区域

decisions.zh: 把领先从一人扩大到两人，还是去争另一个空区？
decisions.en: Extend a one-unit lead or contest another area?

decisions.zh: 继续追赶已落后的地区，还是放弃并保住其他收益？
decisions.en: Chase a deficit or concede it to preserve other rewards?

effect.zh: 持续判定强化即时控制，阶段结算强化临近结算的反超。
effect.en: Continuous control rewards immediate presence; timed scoring rewards late reversals.

effect.zh: 无人控制、共享奖励与特定阵营胜出会产生不同争夺门槛。
effect.en: No control, shared rewards and faction advantages create different thresholds.

observation.zh: 系统参考图：选中的林地空地中可见建筑与单位，手牌位于画面下方。
observation.en: System reference: Buildings and units occupy the selected forest clearing, with cards below. See the linked text source for the rules.

implementation.zh: 通常由战士与建筑合计最多的一方统治空地；一般平局无人统治，飞鹰王朝等明确规则会改变平局结果。
implementation.en: A clearing is normally ruled by the faction with the most warriors and buildings combined; ties normally mean no ruler, with explicit exceptions such as the Eyrie.

cases.rights: Artefacts Studio / Twin Sails Interactive / Hans im Glück

observation.zh: 系统参考图：拼接地图上可见城市、道路、草地与随从。
observation.en: System reference: Cities, roads, fields and followers occupy the connected tile map. See the linked text source for the rules.

implementation.zh: 不同玩家先分别占据的城市可以随着板块连接而合并，完成时按随从多数结算；人数并列最多者都得到该地形的完整分数。
implementation.en: Cities occupied separately can merge as tiles connect; completed features award points by follower majority, with tied leaders each scoring the full feature value.

contrast.zh: 茂林源记的统治还影响移动与行动资格；卡卡颂把多数竞争与地形合并、完工结算联系起来。
contrast.en: Root uses rule to affect movement and action eligibility; Carcassonne links majorities to merging features and completion scoring.

combination.zh: 组合提案：设施的服务范围产生影响力，但同一区域的服务名额归覆盖最多的一方，迫使玩家比较巩固旧区与开拓新区。
combination.en: Design proposal: facility coverage generates influence, with service rights going to the strongest local coverage; compare reinforcing a district with opening a new one.

setup.zh: 北区双方各两枚标记，南区你有一枚、对手没有。
setup.en: The north is tied at two each; you have one marker in the south and the opponent none.

action.en: Put the new marker in the north.

result.zh: 以三比二获得北区领先。
result.en: You lead the north three to two.

next.zh: 对手还能增援，决定下一枚用于守北区还是扩大南区。
next.en: The opponent can reinforce; choose whether the next marker protects the north or expands south.

firstStep.zh: 三个区域、每人六枚标记和一个固定结算回合，用颜色块即可。
firstStep.en: Use three areas, six markers per player and a fixed scoring round.

pitfall.zh: 必须让当前数量、领先者与结算时点同时可见。
pitfall.en: Keep counts, leaders and scoring time visible together.

test.zh: 玩家是否会停止给已稳占的区域加人，转去争新的区域？
test.en: Do players stop overcommitting to secure areas and contest new ones?
